newsitem.title: USA: American Greetings ends Foster buy talks.
newsitem.headline: American Greetings ends Foster buy talks.

text.p: American Greetings Corp said Tuesday it has ended talks to buy the Foster Grant Group from BEC Group.

"We have decided that going forward with this acquisition at this time does not fit with our business objectives," said Erwin Weiss, senior vice president of American Greetings' consumer products division.

BEC Group Inc also responded, saying, "We were unable to agree on philosophies and price with American Greetings. As a result, we are returning to the management-led buyout of Foster Grant that we had originally intended prior to the American Greetings offer."
BEC said it expects to close on such a deal before the release of its third-quarter results.
